assumption_register.assumption: Cancellation can remain pending while a CPU is idle.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Consume cancellation under the same deadline, without synthetic guest Hlt.
assumption_register.stress_test: Idle cancellation followed by genuine shutdown; two/four CPUs over eight rounds.

assumption_register.assumption: The existing 5 ms cancellation worker and operational SDK can service a finite host turn, excluding host/kernel latency.
assumption_register.basis: Existing worker period and retained SDK blocking/cancellation API.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Admit intervals at least 5 ms; reject impossible conversions before entry.
assumption_register.stress_test: Zero, 1 ns, period-minus-1 ns, 5 ms, 10 ms, u64::MAX ns and Duration::MAX.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Invalid limit enters the guest, resets a deadline, or claims a hard real-time guarantee.
assumption_register.status: retained operational assumption; interval partitions and physical invalid-state preservation tested

assumption_register.assumption: A nonzero SDK cancellation result must prohibit subsequent entry and capture.
assumption_register.basis: Cancellation is required to regain control; a failure cannot be represented as a healthy export.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Retain first nonzero result atomically; check in ensure_live.
assumption_register.stress_test: Later successes, differing errors, extreme i32 statuses and eight concurrent writers.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A success clears a failure, a later failure replaces it, or entry/capture bypasses ensure_live.
assumption_register.status: pure boundary/concurrency cases passed; no physical SDK fault injection claimed
